prediction_boundary.variable: q_u integer coder count for current bit u
prediction_boundary.source_location: wiki-loom:after route lookup, auxiliary byte-distribution conditionalization, and SAFE-MIX
prediction_boundary.before: only state through the preceding decoded bit, the field-entry awake decision, parent count, auxiliary conditional count, and pre-truth posterior are available
prediction_boundary.after: q_u is clipped and quantized exactly once and supplied unchanged to the authoritative arithmetic coder

update.equation: At each bounded field entry, derive descriptor r from already decoded template and field bytes, look up slot j=H(r)&4095, and freeze awake iff the exact fingerprint hits with prior support at least 128 bytes. For each current byte x, compute authoritative parent counts p_u normally. If awake, read current parent recurrent parameters without writing them, evaluate the auxiliary byte distribution from slot state (h_j,c_j), condition it on decoded current-byte prefix bits to obtain d_u, and code q_u=SAFE_MIX_V1(p_u,d_u,w_u); otherwise q_u=p_u and w is unchanged. After each truth bit, advance the parent and coder only through ordinary transitions and update w only for awake bits. After all eight bits, advance only (h_j,c_j) through one no-train recurrent transition using x and the frozen parent ByteMixer input ordering, then update the bounded parser. No auxiliary value is copied into parent state.

lifecycle.activate: only inside a bounded template field value whose descriptor was complete before the first value byte and whose state-bank fingerprint hit with at least 128 prior bytes at field entry
lifecycle.reset: on a descriptor fingerprint miss, the selected auxiliary hidden/cell slot is reset only after the current field is declared sleeping; parent and global mixture state never reset

numeric_contract.format: source-bound qualified-parent IEEE-754 recurrent arithmetic plus gamma_safe_mix_v1 fixed integer probability arithmetic
numeric_contract.rounding: inherit the content-addressed parent compile and SAFE-MIX rules exactly; no additional float contraction or probability conversion is permitted
numeric_contract.overflow: descriptor, parser, state, or numeric overflow makes the specialist sleep or fails closed before coder output according to the frozen source contract
numeric_contract.accumulation_order: ordinary parent source order, auxiliary no-train recurrent source order, byte-prefix conditionalization in ascending byte value, then SAFE-MIX integer source order

mixture.rule: gamma_safe_mix_v1 two-expert integer law over authoritative parent and awake WIKI-LOOM auxiliary recurrence
mixture.posterior_scope: one global causal posterior retained across every field, invocation, page, and route
mixture.sleeping_behavior: outside an awake field the coder receives P exactly and the posterior is neither updated nor reset

controls.K: identical parser, routing, state-bank, auxiliary transition, sleeping, mixture-bookkeeping, and hashes while supplying P to the coder and forbidding mechanism writes into parent state
controls.R: the same 4,096-slot recurrent bank routed by frozen SplitMix of causal page, invocation, and field ordinals instead of the semantic descriptor
controls.S: the same recurrent bank routed by the immediately preceding completed field descriptor at the current field's matched eligible bytes

ceilings.reject_only_futility_rule: At the sealed opening-10M gate, reject only after M's final exact net gain is below 50,000 bytes or an exactness, control, chronological, resource, or dependency predicate fails; partial ideal loss is not archive authority.
